steering: Blend Straight to the point and A little character. Prefer the latter's softer color treatment. No Understand / Build / Care submenu. Art is optional and must explain the copy. Generate three distinct options on this theme.

candidates.label: A personal introduction
candidates.structure: One continuous reading column pairs the introduction and offer, with work evidence in a quiet adjoining margin.

candidates.label: The problem and the response
candidates.structure: A compact title precedes consecutive full-width problem and response passages, with the response carrying the booking action.

candidates.label: Room to focus
candidates.structure: Centered compact headline, lead and action; two explanatory columns below; a softly tinted assessment section follows. No illustration.

candidates.label: Work, made clearer
candidates.structure: Headline and lead face the three exact problem sentences; a small flat connector diagram joins these to the explanatory paragraph below. Pale mustard offer follows.

candidates.label: An open letter
candidates.structure: A narrow left-aligned title and sequential prose share a single uninterrupted column; the assessment closes the reading passage before work proof.

candidates.label: Work alongside the words
candidates.structure: Introduction and primary action occupy a main column; a clearly subordinate real work excerpt occupies the right third; offer forms a separate lower section.

candidates.label: The message, up front
candidates.structure: Headline and strong lead share an open horizontal opening; aligned prose columns follow beneath them with an inline booking action. A pale mustard assessment section then returns to cream for real work.
